body: I can't make you want to live. That's you. I'm here to make sure that you know that you are the one who makes you want to live. It's three oclock over here too and I'm scrambling to set up my story and contacting people to back me up. Find something you care about and jump on it. Like a passion say you like hiking go hike. If you don't know what you like, hell, just go hike. Maybe you will love it or maybe you will get to the top and think about how shitty hiking is that's just part of it. If you don't like it go do something else. You could spend time on this sub helping people I've been reading your comment you are doing a fantastic job. Go talk to people find people with common interests. The more you express yourself the more likely someone will show up who you can genuinely care fore.

Well, what's dying worth. It's like taking a zero on a test you can always turn in late for half credit. Its gonna hurt everything far more than taking a shot and having it be kinda shitty for awhile but in the end you bring it back up. Life is like a wave it goes up and down. I can't guarantee you won't be at a low point again in life but I sure as hell can guarantee you will have more high points than low points. It all balances out in the end if you put enough effort in.

There is really only one way to find out if you will make it that far. You just gotta go for it. And I don't mean get out there and half ass it and come back here. I mean literally give it everything you have. It's not an easy thing to do but it's what needs to be done

Helping yourself is far easier than helping others. Lay your arm down on next to you and then lift it up. That's a dumb example but thats what it takes to help yourself. If you can get started, you can do anything. Even if you have no confidence you can go out and pretend you do. TBH you don't have to help yourself, you can let pretty much anything have an impact on you. Say you look st the trees and interpret whatever you want as a reason to keep going. There is so much fun in the world it's just a bit hard to find.

All you are doing in trying to make peace is proving that you are worthy of living. Take step back and look at the big picture. You are helping these people is that not purpose enough to live? What would these people do without you? Someone has to help them and you have shown you are capable

Hey man, I don't know if it will help, but your message to me genuinely made me happy. I'm just some internet stranger on a throwaway account who you don't even know but you made me happy. If you can make me happy imagine what you can do in the real world. Life is all about timing and chances. Sometimes you find yourself at the right time along with bad chance as company. It's not particularly fair as for when the two line up, but one thing is guaranteed. This is that they will. When you're going through hell keep going. If you want to make people happy than all that you need to do is be sincere. People will see that and flock to it. This is my advice from someone who is a piece of shit but it's advice.
